parsed.note_claim: A Russian drone hit the locomotive of a regular Kyiv–Warsaw train ~2 km inside Ukraine; no injuries.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Today in the Volyn region, two kilometres from the Polish border, the enemy struck the locomotive of a passenger train... ensuring that no one was injured.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly confirms the drone struck the train's locomotive 2km from the border and that no one was injured.
